requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model named MalpracticeSignal with fields: state_board_actions (list), npdb_flag (boolean or null), action_count (integer), severity_score (float), and evidence_links (list of URLs).
The system must allow state_board_actions to be an empty list when no actions are present.
The system must allow state_board_actions to be null when data is unavailable or unknown.
The system must support npdb_flag values of true, false, or null to represent confirmed presence, confirmed absence, or unknown status.
The system must ensure action_count is equal to the length of state_board_actions when the list is present.
The system must set action_count to null when state_board_actions is null.
The system must define severity_score as a derived field and not accept it as direct input in the schema constructor.
The system must ensure severity_score is less than or equal to zero when any malpractice signal is present.
The system must ensure severity_score equals zero when no malpractice signals are present (empty list and npdb_flag false).
The system must not assign a positive severity_score under any condition.
The system must validate that all entries in evidence_links are well-formed URLs.
The system must allow evidence_links to be an empty list when no supporting links are available.
The system must raise a validation error if state_board_actions is provided as a non-list type.
The system must raise a validation error if evidence_links contains non-string or malformed URL entries.
